entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A character who journeys into Mirrodin's core to confront Memnarch; her body calls forth the green mana that becomes the green sun.

entities.name: Bosh
entities.description: A companion who travels with Glissa and Slobad to confront Memnarch.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: A companion who travels with Glissa and Bosh to confront Memnarch.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The insidious ruler at Mirrodin's core who seizes the Kaldra avatar and turns it on Glissa and her companions.

entities.name: Kaldra avatar
entities.description: An immensely powerful being of energy summoned when Kaldra's sword, shield and helm were brought together; Memnarch turns it against Glissa.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The artificial world with five suns whose core is the site of the confrontation with Memnarch.

entities.name: The Tangle
entities.description: A region of Mirrodin into which the avatar pursues Glissa.

entities.name: The Radix
entities.description: The place on Mirrodin where Glissa's destiny becomes clear and the avatar is destroyed.

entities.name: Kaldra
entities.description: Three artifacts (sword, shield and helm) which together summon the Kaldra avatar.

events.summary: Glissa, Bosh and Slobad journey to Mirrodin's core with the Kaldra avatar to confront Memnarch.
events.quote: journey deep within Mirrodin's core to confront the insidious Memnarch

events.summary: Memnarch seizes the Kaldra avatar with a single spell and turns it on Glissa and her companions.
events.quote: Memnarch seizes the avatar with a single spell and turns it on Glissa and her companions.

events.summary: The avatar pursues Glissa into the Tangle, destroying everything in its way.
events.quote: Kaldra's avatar relentlessly pursues Glissa into the Tangle

events.summary: At the Radix, Glissa's body calls forth a column of green mana from Mirrodin's core that annihilates the avatar.
events.quote: Glissa's body calls forth a great column of green mana from Mirrodin's core, annihilating the avatar in the process.

events.summary: The green mana hangs overhead as a glowing sphere, the green sun and Mirrodin's fifth dawn.
events.quote: the green sun at last, Mirrodin's fifth dawn

relations.note: Glissa and companions go to confront Memnarch.
relations.quote: journey deep within Mirrodin's core to confront the insidious Memnarch

relations.note: Memnarch seizes the avatar and turns it on Glissa.
relations.quote: Memnarch seizes the avatar with a single spell and turns it on Glissa and her companions.

relations.note: Her green mana annihilates the avatar.
relations.quote: annihilating the avatar in the process.
